explication: Bitwarden’s iOS repository contains a password-manager application plus a separate Authenticator experience. The principal workflow is: a user launches the app or an extension, application orchestration selects authentication and routing, account services unlock or establish a session, and vault services load, decrypt, generate, and display items. Authenticator-specific flows additionally scan or manually enter TOTP secrets, persist encrypted items, and refresh codes. The tree also documents import/export, autofill, biometric unlock, share/action extensions, shortcuts, and watch synchronization. Several central implementations were not sampled, so some subsystem links remain conservative.
